model_artifact.shipped_via: assets/ → internal storage (copyRawFileToInternalStorage) → FileProvider URI → CAAS FileShareActivity

findings.title: Exported ContentProvider returns the entire LLM system-prompt corpus to any caller, with no caller verification or URI validation
findings.rationale: The provider is declared `android:exported="true"` (no signature permission, no path-permission allow-list). `query()` ignores the URI, projection, selection, sortOrder — for any query it reads `assets/prompts.json` and ships it as a single-row Cursor. `prompts.json` is the LLM's system-prompt corpus (the rules that constrain Gleo's behaviour, mapped to vehicle-control commands). Any installed app can read it via `content://ai.pleos.playground.llm.model.provider.prompts/...` and use the contents to: (1) mount prompt-injection or jailbreak attacks against the LLM by replicating exact phrasing the model treats as authoritative, (2) reverse-engineer the safety guards. Mitigation: protect with a signature-level permission, or remove `exported=true` and use `grantUriPermissions` only when forwarding an Intent.

findings.title: Exported receiver acts on caller-controlled custom actions FILE_SHARE_COMPLETE / PROMPTS_QUERY_COMPLETE without any signature gate
findings.rationale: The manifest declares this receiver `exported="true"` with `<intent-filter>` containing the custom actions, and there is no `android:permission="..."` attribute. Any third-party app can send a broadcast with action `ai.pleos.llm.model.provider.intent.action.SHARE_FILE_COMPLETE` (literal name observed in the manifest <queries> block) which routes into `deleteLLMModelFile` (`new File(context.getFilesDir(), LLM_MODEL_FILE_NAME).delete()`). Sending both actions trips `checkAndStopProcess` → `Process.killProcess(Process.myPid())`. Net effect: a non-privileged app can (a) delete the local copy of the GGUF model, (b) kill the provider process. This is a denial-of-service primitive against an on-device LLM that the rest of PleOS depends on. Mitigation: gate the receiver with `ai.pleos.caas.EVENT_PERMISSION` (already declared) or a signature permission.

negative_confirmations: No INTERNET permission — model is local; no exfiltration vector via this app's process

LLMModelProviderService is exported=false. IPC uses FileProvider URIs with FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION and an explicit ComponentName (`ai.pleos.playground.caas/ai.pleos.playground.caas.service.llm.FileShareActivity`) — the file-share path is correctly scoped
FileProvider scope (`file_paths.xml`) is `<files-path name="shared_files" path="."/>` — bounds the URI grant to the app's `getFilesDir()`
